why: The capture reads pads after the menu poller on the same page frame. Read first, the press that completes a capture ends it and rewrites the layout before the poller runs, so the poller reads that same press through the NEW layout: X chosen for Back is Back already, and backs out of the pane on the press that only chose it. (A B chosen for Fire does not show this: once bound, B is no longer Back under either order -- the first measurement of this entry survived on that test.)
killedBy: createRouteHost: the gamepad menu poller (issue #494) reads a capture AFTER the menu poller: Back moved onto X does not back out on the press that moved it (issue #754)
